node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 coordinate-transpose transport
node.closure: endpoint-axis transport of the transposed coordinate subgroup to a fresh source record in the proved coordinate chain
node.statement: The endpoint self-correspondence f(T)=f(W) is invariant under transposition. Thus every actual order-two component with stabilizer <1 x tau> transposes to an actual component with stabilizer <tau x 1>. After exchanging endpoint roles, one must rerun the degree-two source reduction on the new second projection; the resulting primed source record satisfies the complete coordinate source-facet, parity, colored-resultant, and Vieta-rank chain. Hence the two coordinate subgroups are one existence/deletion route, while their source presentations are not identified and the diagonal route remains separate.
